stem:
Hemant knows six test scores have mean $12$. Five of the scores are $10$, $11$, $14$, $9$ and $13$. One score is missing.

Which two claims correctly recover the missing score?

options.text: Treat the known mean $12$ itself as the missing score.
Call the answer the number of values $6$ alone.

teacher.key_rationale: Mean×count gives total 72; subtract the five known scores to get missing 15. Using the mean or the count alone as the missing score skips recovering the total.
